text: キメ　こまかく　しなやかな　たいもうは　うっとりするほど。

structure.jp: キメ　こまかく　しなやかな　たいもうは

structure.en: is enough to leave you entranced

patterns.name: 〜ほど
patterns.explanation: ほど after a verb says something is so much that this happens. うっとりするほど = 'so much that you are entranced'.

patterns.name: 〜く (linking)
patterns.span: こまかく　しなやかな
patterns.explanation: Changing the last い of a describing word to く lets you add another describing word, like 'and'. こまかく　しなやかな = 'fine and supple'.
